name: Detritus: Trashtective
source:
In a world where everything is made of trash augmented with LEDs you, Raz Berri, are the only one up to the task of tracking down and saving your p̶r̶o̶b̶a̶b̶l̶y̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶r̶o̶u̶b̶l̶e̶ girlfriend.

Collect clues, talk to witnesses, explore the city of Detritus, and more!! All in the name of love, to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your Cherry Pi.

[From [url=https://single-cell-studios.itch.io/detritus-trashtective]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个一切都是由LED增强的垃圾组成的世界里，你，Raz Berri，是唯一一个能够追踪并拯救你的p̶r̶o̶b̶a̶b̶l̶y̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶r̶o̶u̶b̶l̶e̶ 女朋友的人。

收集线索、与目击者交谈、探索碎石城等等！一切以爱的名义，揭开Cherry Pi失踪背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://single-cell-studios.itch.io/detritus-trashtective]Itch.io[/url]]
